turns.text: Hello there, how are you doing today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My old laptop is dying and I need a new one before next month.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. First big question, do you want something small and light to carry around, or a bigger screen for working at a desk?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Give me a moment, I'm going to talk to my friend. Stay quiet until you hear I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Zoe, are you still coming to the gallery opening on Friday?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I want to, but what time does it start?

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: friend

turns.speaker: user

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Oh, I remember those. They were huge.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So where did we leave it?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure. We were deciding whether your new laptop should be light or have a big screen.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Light. I carry it to cafes almost every day.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then look at thirteen or fourteen inch models with long battery life.
